title: Histogram bins
description: Number of bins across the chart (the mania 100 window either side of 0 ms). Rounded up to an odd count so one bin sits on 0 ms; clamped to 9–61.

title: Per-column release
description: Shows each column's mean release error under the chart. Needs ENABLE_MANIA_KEY_HIT_ERRORS = true in the vosu config; without it a one-line note names the setting.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag in the panel header.
